exam.title: SnowPro Associate: Platform
exam.study_prerequisites: Retired May 4, 2026 and no longer schedulable. New learners should complete the free Snowflake University Platform Skills course and assessment for its non-expiring educational badge, then consider active COF-C03 for a proctored SnowPro credential. Practice account/object context, stages and virtual warehouses, structured/semi-structured/unstructured loads, least-privilege role hierarchies, data protection/sharing, and current Cortex AI SQL functions in a disposable account.

review.notes: The six last published capabilities are preserved without invented weights and mapped to current technical documentation. Retirement, replacement date, badge non-expiry, holder treatment and badge-versus-SnowPro distinction come from the official transition FAQ. Three scenarios, eight authorized labs and 36 checks are included. The former landing page disappeared during validation, so the dated snapshot is frozen and all seven surviving URLs were rechecked as reachable. No recalled item, dump or copied course content is used.

findings.title: Retired monitor skip is not a current unchanged-blueprint check
The active replacement course has verifiable public duration and lab terms
Badge1 is a distinct learning route with conflicting effort estimates
Old notebook creation guidance needs a current workflow boundary
Old only-NOT-NULL enforcement assumptions are incomplete
File-load tracking is not an indefinite business-event ledger
Null-looking results can conceal a parse failure
Effective read access differs from object-creation authority
Full qualification does not bypass a same-name temporary table
Warehouse controls do not cap all account consumption
Removing a narrow AI permission can leave broad access intact
A transition milestone does not prove account-wide enforcement
